entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed seeking relief that the FIR registered on 21.10.2022 and crime registered vide Crime No.0364/2022 at Police Station - Kirnapur, District- Balaghat, under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468 and 120-B of I.P.C. with Section 21(1)(2)(3) of the Prohibition of Irregular Deposit Scheme Adhiniyam, 2019, against the present petitioners, be quashed.

entities.text: Prohibition of Irregular Deposit Scheme Adhiniyam, 2019
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. The parties have entered into settlement.
Their statements have been recorded before the Registry, which are available on record.
As per the statements of the parties, they settled the matter ex curia and whatever payment was made by the complainant to the petitioners has been received by him and is paid by the petitioners.
The complainant (respondent No.2), therefore, do not want to prosecute the matter.

3. Considering the aforesaid, since it is a dispute between two private parties and some of the offences registered against the petitioners, are not compoundable, but looking to the impact over the society, the offence even though not compoundable, can be quashed in view of the compromise and settlement, if any, takes place between the parties.
4. In view of the above, this Courts finds it a fit case in which the petition can be allowed and ex-consequentia, the FIR registered against the petitioners is hereby quashed.
Resultantly, all the consequential proceedings arising out of the said crime number shall also be quashed.
5. The petition stands allowed, accordingly.
(SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE PKP Madhuri Chornele vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185986834/
